completed_slice: Bound provenance coverage_result labels to the underlying completeness and exclusion evidence so receipts cannot overstate or contradict their actual search surface.
durable_memory: Coverage class is derived from evidence, not declared independently: complete = complete ref inventory + complete history traversal + zero exclusions; complete_with_declared_exclusions = complete structural traversal + one or more named exclusions; incomplete must not contradict fully complete evidence.

claim_classes.proposed: Require fail-closed semantic consistency for every receipt regardless of claim transition status.
claim_classes.superseded: A syntactically valid coverage_result is sufficient to establish coverage class.
